pages.title: The work
pages.text:
**Assignment list:** chapter **Strand: Sigil**.

Gate: two of Clock, Swarm, Spark **seated**. Then a Strand Filament in hand, right-click the Post: **Braid Cord**.

Seals and rites — Tribal Power's own, with Nature's Aura, Ars Nouveau, and Occultism as peers. Finish the **Sigil Knot** and seat Sigil.

pages.title: Bind
pages.text: The Seal-carvers pressed spirit into matter and made it stay. Never bind what you would not be willing to unbind.
